description: List tags, or get one tag's full detail by name or guid. query/limit/offset filter and page the list, returning { total, hasMore, nextOffset, tags }; with none of them the full tag array is returned.

guid.description: If set, return just this tag (looked up by GUID).

limit.description: Max tags per page (1-1000). Default: all matches.

name.description: If set, return just this tag (looked up by name).

offset.description: Tags to skip (default: 0). Use nextOffset to page.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on tag names.

name: evernote_list_tags
title: List tags
